title: When to Use ‘Some’ and Not ‘A’ or ‘An’ (3/3)
titleZh: 什麼時候該用 some 而不是 a 或 an (3/3)
summaryZh: 用新聞報導當例子，總結 a、an 和 some 各自該搭配哪種名詞。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Everyday Grammar

sentences.text: And every workday here at Learning English, we write a story, count noun, for you about the latest news, a non-count noun.
sentences.zh: 在 Learning English，我們每個上班日都會為你寫一篇報導，story 是可數名詞，內容是最新的消息，news 則是不可數名詞。

sentences.text: The editor asked me to write a story about some news from Asia.
sentences.zh: 編輯要我寫一篇關於亞洲某些消息的報導。

sentences.text: To sum up, you can use a or an before singular count nouns, and some before plural count nouns, and any non-count nouns.
sentences.zh: 總結來說，單數可數名詞前面可以用 a 或 an，複數可數名詞和任何不可數名詞前面則用 some。
以上就是今天的 Everyday Grammar。
